name: osg-e2e
description: Real-binary Windows journeys driven through tauri-driver and the actual WebView.

scripts.$comment: ONE SPEC PER INVOCATION. Every journey starts from a first run, and the run root is created when wdio.conf.js loads -- once per invocation, not once per spec. Passing several --spec flags to one invocation makes spec two open a database spec one already filled, so the application restores that project and the first-run controls never appear. Measured: unicodeCues and urlToPreview both pass alone and both fail together, on '.url-field still not displayed' and 'the selected media never became playable'.
scripts.test: wdio run wdio.conf.js --spec ./journeys/startup.journey.js && wdio run wdio.conf.js --spec ./journeys/defaultFont.journey.js
scripts.test:workflows: wdio run wdio.conf.js --spec ./journeys/urlToPreview.journey.js && wdio run wdio.conf.js --spec ./journeys/editPersistRelaunch.journey.js && wdio run wdio.conf.js --spec ./journeys/unicodeCues.journey.js
